candidate.title: JVMTI native agent
candidate.rejectionReason: JVMTI reaches the same hook through a raw C environment table: an exported Agent_OnLoad, a jvmtiEnv function-table dereference per capability, event callback registration, and class retransformation. It buys nothing the java.lang.instrument agent does not already provide for this hook shape, while adding unsafe surface that no audited crate encapsulates.
